programs.name: Health Start Academy
programs.summary: Specialized health sciences career pathway offering rigorous hands-on clinical coursework, college dual credit, and opportunities to test for entry-level healthcare industry credentials.
opportunities: Earn dual college credits through MCC–Penn Valley Health Science Institute
Opportunity to earn Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) credential
Opportunity to earn Pharmacology Technician credential
Opportunity to earn Phlebotomy / Sterile Services certifications
Direct clinical immersion and healthcare workforce mentorship
programs.application_window: January – April for following school year entry
unknowns: Current annual cohort seat cap for Health Start
Program-specific district bus transportation schedule for clinical sites

programs.name: Early College Academy
programs.summary: District-funded early college program allowing eligible Ruskin juniors and seniors to earn up to 42 transferable college credits while completing their high school diploma.
opportunities: Earn up to 42 college credits tuition-free, covered by Hickman Mills C-1
Substantial head start toward an Associate or Bachelor's degree
Complete general education college coursework while in high school
eligibility_rules: Cumulative unweighted GPA of 3.0 or higher
Qualifying score on MCC Accuplacer placement examination

programs.name: MCC Allied Health & Nursing Pathways
programs.summary: Postsecondary career pathways spanning entry-level rapid certifications to 2-year Associate of Applied Science (AAS) professional degrees in acute healthcare disciplines.
opportunities: Short-term certificate pathways: CNA, EMT, Phlebotomy, Medical Assisting (1-2 semesters)
Two-year AAS degrees: Registered Nursing (RN), Radiologic Technology, Surgical Technology, Occupational Therapy Assistant
High regional wage premiums and acute local hospital hiring demand
unknowns: Specific selective admission TEAS exam cutoffs by clinical cohort
